card.name: Inside kidney and filtration terms
card.fires_on: Middle pieces of long medical words about the kidney or filtration, such as neph-rop-athy, neph-ro-toxicity, ultra-filtr-ate and methot-rex-ate. It fires on the piece just before the word ending.

modes.label: Nephro- words
modes.description: Middle piece of nephropathy or nephrotoxicity.
modes.example: Polyoma Virus Neph<<rop>>athy In addition to cases of JC virus

modes.label: Ultrafiltrate words
modes.description: Middle piece of ultrafiltrate or ultrafiltration in dialysis flow rates.
modes.example: CVVH, dialysis flow rate for CVVHD, ultra<<filtr>>ate flow rate plus dialysis flow rate

modes.label: Methotrexate
modes.description: Piece inside methotrexate before its ending.
modes.example: Serum creatinine and methot<<rex>>ate levels should be determined at least once
